reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Improving durable solutions for displaced populations in White Nile.

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective (impact) of this action is to improve access to basic rights and services for marginalised displacement-affected populations in Khartoum.

The intervention will contribute to three specific objectives (outcomes) which address key elements of the Action document for Durable Solutions for forcibly displaced populations in Sub-Saharan Africa, and considers the required conditions set out in the IASC (Interagency Standing Committee) Framework for Durable Solutions to support displacement affected populations in accessing an appropriate solution.

The Specific Objectives (Outcomes) of this action are:

i. Refugees and host communities will benefit from improved and more equitable access to services.

ii. Target communities will benefit from improvements in physical safety and functionality of services through strategic investments in community infrastructure.

iii. The protective environment of refugees and those who host them is improved in the long term through targeting individuals, communities, and service providers with skills and resources which reduce their exposure to risk and threats.

NB: Due to war eruption in April 2023, the project was moved from Khartoum to White Nile State of Sudan. New amended title:Improving durable solutions for displaced populations in Khartoum White Nile
